title_en: Cooking Chinese Dishes (19/20): Lap Cheong (Chinese Sausage)
note_en: 之所以A，是因为B means "the reason A is that B," putting the result before the cause: 之所以只有腊月才适合做这些风干食品，是因为… "the reason only the twelfth lunar month is right for making these air-dried foods is that…." English usually leads with "because," but formal Chinese often states the fact first with 之所以 and explains it after 是因为.
